description: Check a custom HTML in-app message document before using it as a format "html" in-app step. Returns its size against the 100 KB limit, Braze Liquid conversions (e.g. {{${email_address}}} becomes {{email}}, {{${braze_id}}} becomes {{contactId}}), script hosts a website CSP must allow, whether it closes itself, warnings and blocking errors. Nothing is saved.
